turns.assessment: The only positive symptom is a large pre-FEC BER increase at the S24 receiver of och175. Its received power, estimated OSNR, DGD, and SOP rate remain unchanged, while the amplifiers and channel monitors on the optical route show no correlated change; this strongly favors receiver-local degradation over a line or amplifier fault. An upstream channel-specific WSS filter shift remains a smaller alternative because it can impair quality without changing power.

proposals.rationale: The BER degradation is confined to this receiver with normal optical-path indicators and no effects on neighboring services, matching RX_PENALTY at this receiver.
A channel-specific shifted or narrowed WSS passband could raise BER while leaving received power and estimated OSNR unchanged, but there is no direct filter-related observation.
Reduced channel margin can appear at this receiver, but the distinct onset near t=600 s is less consistent with the documented slow decline.
